MRI Information
MR Conditional (1.5 T): spatial field gradient ≤ 40 T/m (4000 G/cm); whole body SAR not to exceed 4 W/kg; Normal Operating Mode or First Level Controlled Operating Mode; Limit total active scanning to 10 min; Wait 5 minutes before the next imaging session; Body transmit coil or head transmit coil.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
